States run SNAP (food stamps) but federal taxpayers cover more than 90% of its costs, an all-gain, no-pain setup that contributed to $10.1 billion in improper payments last year. The surest fix for waste, fraud, and abuse in SNAP is for states to pay for it, writes Cato's @RominaBoccia and Tyler Turman.
